intuition: A query asks whether any stored word is a suffix of the stream, so reading both words and stream backward shares useful prefixes.

brute_force.approach: Append each letter and compare the accumulated suffix against every word.
brute_force.time: query O(number of words times maximum word length)

optimal.approach: Store reversed words in a trie and traverse at most the longest word length from a bounded history deque.
optimal.time: query O(maximum word length), construction O(total word characters)
optimal.space: O(total word characters + maximum word length)

edge_cases: A word may match immediately after one query.
The retained history never needs to exceed the longest dictionary word.
